models.name: todo_app_system_settings
models.description:
System configuration and application-wide settings that govern the baseline behavior and operational parameters of the todo application.

This table stores critical application settings including rate limits, feature toggles, maintenance modes, and global configuration options. Settings are typically managed by system administrators and referenced by application logic to enforce constraints and control application behavior.

The configuration is designed to be flexible and scalable, supporting different deployment environments and operational requirements without requiring code changes. Settings include both technical parameters and business rule definitions that control the user experience across the entire application.

plainFields.name: setting_key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the configuration setting. Used as a reference key in application code to retrieve specific configuration values.

plainFields.name: setting_value
plainFields.description: The actual configuration value for this setting. Can store various data types as serialized strings including numbers, JSON objects, or simple text.

plainFields.name: setting_type
plainFields.description: Data type classification for this setting (e.g., 'string', 'number', 'boolean', 'json'). Used by the application to properly parse and validate setting values.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description explaining the purpose and usage of this configuration setting. Helps administrators understand what each setting controls.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this configuration setting is currently active and should be considered by the application. Allows for soft-disabling without deletion. Default: true.

plainFields.name: environment_scope
plainFields.description: Deployment environment where this setting applies (e.g., 'development', 'staging', 'production'). Supports different configs per environment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration setting was created. Used for audit purposes and change tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration setting was last modified. Tracks configuration changes over time.

models.name: todo_app_validation_rules
models.description:
Validation rules and constraints that enforce data quality and business logic across the todo application.

This table defines the validation criteria for various data inputs including field length limits, format requirements, and business rule constraints. Validation rules are referenced by application logic to ensure data integrity and provide consistent error messages to users.

Rules include format validation for emails, data type checks, range constraints, and custom business logic validations that apply system-wide. The flexible rule definition system allows for easy updates and additions as business requirements evolve.

plainFields.name: rule_key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for this validation rule. Used as a reference key in application logic to apply specific validation criteria.

plainFields.name: rule_name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name for this validation rule. Used for administrative interfaces and error message generation.

plainFields.name: validation_type
plainFields.description: Type of validation rule (e.g., 'length', 'format', 'range', 'custom'). Determines how the rule is applied during validation.

plainFields.name: field_target
plainFields.description: Target field or data type this rule applies to (e.g., 'task.title', 'user.email', 'category.name'). Specifies what the rule validates.

plainFields.name: constraint_definition
plainFields.description: JSON definition of the validation constraints including min/max values, patterns, or custom logic. Defines the actual validation criteria.

plainFields.name: error_message_template
plainFields.description: Template for error messages when this rule fails validation. Supports placeholders for field names and constraint values.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this validation rule is currently enforced. Allows disabling rules without deletion for maintenance or temporary issues. Default: true.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Priority order for rule application when multiple rules apply to the same field. Lower numbers have higher priority (executed first).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this validation rule was created. Tracks when rules were introduced into the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this validation rule was last modified. Tracks changes to validation criteria over time.

models.name: todo_app_user_limits
models.description:
User-specific limits and quotas that control access to system resources and prevent abuse of the todo application.

This table defines operational limits such as maximum tasks per user, category creation limits, bulk operation constraints, and API rate limits. Limits are customizable per user and help ensure fair resource usage across all users of the application.

The table supports both system-wide defaults and custom limits for specific users or user groups. Limits can be adjusted based on user activity patterns, premium features, or administrative decisions to optimize system performance and user experience.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user this limit applies to. Null values indicate system-wide default limits.

foreignFields.name: constraint_rule_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the validation rule that defines this limit. Links to detailed constraint definitions from validation rules table.

plainFields.name: limit_type
plainFields.description: Type of limit being enforced (e.g., 'task_count', 'category_count', 'bulk_operation_size', 'api_rate'). Defines what resource is being limited.

plainFields.name: limit_value
plainFields.description: The maximum allowed value for this limit (e.g., 1000 for max tasks, 50 for max categories). Zero or negative values indicate no limit.

plainFields.name: period_type
plainFields.description: Time period for which this limit applies (e.g., 'lifetime', 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly'). Determines how limits reset or accumulate.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description explaining the purpose and implications of this user limit. Helps with administrative decisions and user communication.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this user limit is currently enforced. Allows for temporary relaxation or permanent removal of limits without data deletion. Default: true.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this user limit was created or customized for this user. Tracks when limits were established.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this user limit was last modified. Tracks changes to user-specific limits over time.

models.name: todo_app_operation_logs
models.description:
Operational audit log tracking system events, user actions, and administrative activities for compliance and troubleshooting purposes.

This table records detailed information about various operations including task creation, modification, and deletion events, system configuration changes, and administrative actions. Logs support system monitoring, usage analytics, and troubleshooting capabilities.

The audit trail includes comprehensive event details, user attribution, timing information, and outcome status. Logs are designed for analytical purposes and may be archived or rotated based on retention policies to manage storage requirements while maintaining necessary audit trails.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who initiated this operation. Null for system-initiated events or operations by guest users.

plainFields.name: operation_type
plainFields.description: Type of operation being logged (e.g., 'task.create', 'task.update', 'system.config_change', 'admin.user_management'). Categorizes events for filtering and analysis.

plainFields.name: resource_type
plainFields.description: Type of resource affected by this operation (e.g., 'task', 'category', 'user', 'system'). Links operations to application entities.

plainFields.name: resource_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the specific resource affected by this operation. May reference tasks, users, or other entities depending on resource_type.

plainFields.name: operation_details
plainFields.description: JSON structure containing detailed operation information including before/after states, parameter values, and operation-specific data. Supports comprehensive audit trails.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which the operation was initiated. Used for location analysis and security monitoring. Stored as string to support IPv6.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Browser or client user agent string providing device and software information. Useful for analytics and troubleshooting.

plainFields.name: operation_status
plainFields.description: Outcome of the operation (e.g., 'success', 'failure', 'partial_success'). Tracks whether operations completed successfully.

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Error details if the operation failed. Stores specific failure information for debugging and analysis purposes.

plainFields.name: operation_duration_ms
plainFields.description: Time taken to complete the operation in milliseconds. Useful for performance monitoring and optimization analysis.

plainFields.name: timestamp
plainFields.description: When this operation was performed. Represents the precise time of the logged event.

models.name: todo_app_users
models.description:
Authenticated users of the todo application with full access to create and manage personal tasks.

This table represents registered users who have completed the email verification process and maintain active accounts within the system. Users receive unique identifiers, store hashed passwords for authentication, and can access all core todo functionality including task creation, organization, and completion tracking.

The table stores essential user credentials including encrypted password hashes, ensuring security while maintaining usability. Each user account is independent and maintains strict data isolation preventing cross-user access or visibility of personal tasks and organizational preferences.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User email address used for account authentication and communication. Must be unique across all registered users and follow standard email format validation.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for user authentication. Always stores encrypted hash rather than plain text, meeting modern security standards for credential protection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when user account was created, recorded automatically during registration process for audit trail and account management purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last user account modification, updated automatically when profile information changes for change tracking and audit purposes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for account deactivation. When set, indicates account is inactive and user cannot authenticate, but data is preserved for recovery or compliance purposes.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description:
Authenticated user sessions tracking login activity and connection metadata for security and audit purposes.

Sessions represent individual authenticated access instances for registered users, storing connection details like IP addresses, browser information, and authentication timestamps for security monitoring and session management.

This table maintains security audit trails enabling users to view active sessions, detect potential unauthorized access, and manage their authentication state across multiple devices or browsers. Sessions persist according to user preferences with appropriate expiration mechanisms.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated user's {@link todo_app_users.id}. Links session to specific user account for authentication tracking.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the user connected, stored for security monitoring and session tracking to detect potential unauthorized access attempts.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL or current page location when session was created, helps track user journey and session context for security and debugging purposes.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating how user arrived at the application, useful for understanding user flow and session origination for security and analytics.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp when user successfully authenticated, recorded automatically during login process for session duration tracking.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp when authentication expires according to user preferences. Controls access duration and security timeout behavior.

models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Guest users providing temporary access to explore application features without full registration commitment.

Guest accounts enable prospective users to experience core functionality through demonstration content and basic feature exploration while maintaining clear differentiation from full registered user experiences.

The table provides seamless upgrade pathways when guests decide to register, supporting data preservation and account conversion workflows through unified session management patterns.

plainFields.name: session_identifier
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for guest session tracking, generated automatically for session management and upgrade tracking when guests transition to registered users.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when guest session was initiated, recorded for session duration tracking and analysis of guest engagement patterns.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp for guest session updates, tracked for session management and data export purposes.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Guest session expiration timestamp controlling temporary access duration. Prevents indefinite guest usage and maintains resource management.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Guest user sessions maintaining temporary access tracking and connection metadata for provisional user experiences.

Sessions enable guest users to explore demonstrations and temporary features while collecting audit trails and security information for system monitoring and potential conversion tracking.

This table supports clean session termination when temporary access expires and maintains security standards appropriate for provisional user management while enabling upgrade workflows to full registered accounts.

foreignFields.name: guest_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the guest user's {@link todo_app_guests.id}. Links session to specific guest account for access tracking.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which guest connected, collected for security monitoring and session tracking in temporary user experiences.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL or page location during guest session creation, helps understand guest engagement patterns and session contexts.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL showing how guest arrived at application, useful for analyzing guest acquisition sources and session origins.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp when guest access began, recorded for temporary session duration management and usage tracking.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Guest session expiration timestamp controlling temporary access duration and resource cleanup according to guest policies.

models.name: todo_app_tasks
models.description:
Core task entity representing individual todo items managed by users.

Tasks form the fundamental units of work in the todo application, containing essential information needed for task completion tracking and organization. Each task belongs to a specific user and can be associated with categories and completion records.

The task lifecycle includes states: pending (default), in-progress, and completed. Tasks support prioritization through Low, Medium, and High levels, with Low as the default priority to minimize decision friction. Users can add optional due dates and belong to categories for organization.

Task creation emphasizes minimal required information - only a title is mandatory - with optional fields for descriptions, due dates, priorities, and categories. This design supports rapid task capture while providing flexibility for detailed planning when desired.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_category_id
foreignFields.description: Task's {@link todo_app_categories.id}. Links tasks to categories for organization

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title between 1-200 characters. The essential task description required for creation.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional task description up to 2,000 characters providing additional context or instructions

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Task lifecycle status: pending (default), in-progress, or completed

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Task priority level: Low (default), Medium, or High used for sorting and visual distinction

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for task completion. Validates to prevent past dates and limits to 1 year in future

plainFields.name: completion_order
plainFields.description: Manual sort order for task positioning within user's preferred organization

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Task creation timestamp

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp

models.name: todo_app_categories
models.description:
User-defined organizational categories for grouping related tasks.

Categories provide a hierarchical organization system enabling users to group tasks by project, context, or any classification scheme they choose. Each category belongs to a specific user and contains any number of associated tasks.

Category names must be unique within user accounts and conform to character restrictions to ensure system compatibility. The system limits users to 50 categories maximum to prevent over-complexity while providing sufficient organizational flexibility.

Categories support flexible organization patterns including work/personal divisions, project-based groupings, or contextual organization schemes. Users can filter tasks by category and perform bulk operations on all tasks within a category.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name between 2-50 characters using only letters, numbers, spaces, and hyphens

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional category description providing context about the category's purpose

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Category creation timestamp

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp

models.name: todo_app_task_completions
models.description:
Record of task completion events capturing when tasks are marked complete.

This table tracks the completion lifecycle of tasks, providing accountability and enabling completion statistics calculation. Each completion record represents a unique completion event with timestamps and optional completion notes.

The system supports task reopening by maintaining completion history even when tasks are later reactivated. This allows for productivity analytics including completion rates, time-to-completion, and streak tracking.

Completion records are created when tasks transition to completed status and maintain references back to the original task. Users can add completion notes to document how tasks were accomplished or any relevant outcomes.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_task_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to {@link todo_app_tasks.id} for the completed task

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to {@link todo_app_users.id} of the user who completed the task

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was marked complete

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional notes explaining how the task was completed or any outcomes

plainFields.name: completion_order
plainFields.description: Order of completion for sorting purposes within user's completion history

plainFields.name: reactivated
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if this completion was followed by task reactivation

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Completion record creation timestamp

plainFields.name: reactivated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when task was subsequently reactivated if applicable

models.name: todo_app_task_audit_logs
models.description:
Historical audit trail capturing all modifications to tasks for accountability and recovery.

This table serves as the complete change log for all task operations including creation, updates, completion, category changes, and other modifications. Each entry represents a specific action performed on a task with detailed change tracking.

Audit logs support compliance requirements, provide change history for user reference, and enable system administrators to monitor task lifecycle patterns for improvements. The snapshot approach ensures historical data integrity even as tasks are modified or deleted.

Every task modification creates a new audit log entry capturing the before-and-after state information. This design supports comprehensive change tracking while maintaining optimal performance for current task operations by separating historical data.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to {@link todo_app_users.id} who performed the action

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Type of action performed: CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, COMPLETE, REACTIVATE, MOVE, etc.

plainFields.name: field_changes
plainFields.description: JSON representation of field changes made during this action

plainFields.name: old_value
plainFields.description: Previous value for fields that changed (for single-field changes)

plainFields.name: new_value
plainFields.description: New value for fields that changed (for single-field changes)

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Audit log entry timestamp when the action occurred

models.name: todo_app_user_quotas
models.description:
Individual user quota limits and usage tracking for business rule enforcement.

Tracks each user's consumption against predefined limits like maximum tasks (1000), categories (100), and other resource allocations. Supports both hard limits that prevent further usage and soft limits that trigger warnings.

The quota system prevents system abuse while providing fair resource allocation across all users. Usage metrics are updated atomically to ensure accuracy during high-concurrency scenarios.

Quotas can be configured per user to provide premium features or accommodate special requirements while maintaining system integrity.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: User who owns these quota limits. {@link todo_app_users.id}

plainFields.name: max_tasks
plainFields.description: Maximum number of tasks allowed for this user. Default 1000 for standard users.

plainFields.name: max_categories
plainFields.description: Maximum number of custom categories allowed. Default 100 for standard users.

plainFields.name: max_daily_task_creations
plainFields.description: Maximum tasks that can be created per day. Default 30 to prevent spam.

plainFields.name: current_task_count
plainFields.description: Current number of tasks this user has created. Updated atomically on task operations.

plainFields.name: current_category_count
plainFields.description: Current number of categories created by this user.

plainFields.name: daily_task_creation_count
plainFields.description: Number of tasks created today by this user. Resets at midnight.

plainFields.name: is_premium
plainFields.description: Whether this user has premium quota allowances. Premium users get higher limits.

plainFields.name: quota_reset_date
plainFields.description: Date when daily quotas will reset. Used for tracking daily limits.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When these quota settings were established.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification time for any quota setting.

models.name: todo_app_rate_limits
models.description:
System-wide rate limiting configuration and enforcement tracking.

Manages rate limit rules for different API endpoints and user actions. Tracks both global rate limits (per IP, per endpoint) and user-specific limits to prevent abuse and ensure fair usage.

The rate limiting system implements sliding window counters with automatic reset mechanisms. Different endpoints can have different rate limits based on their resource consumption and frequency patterns.

Supports both authenticated user limits and anonymous IP-based restrictions to protect the system from various attack vectors while maintaining legitimate user access.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Optional user associated with this rate limit. Null for global or IP-based limits. {@link todo_app_users.id}

plainFields.name: limit_name
plainFields.description: Descriptive name for this rate limit rule. Examples: 'task_creation', 'user_registration', 'guest_access'.

plainFields.name: endpoint_pattern
plainFields.description: API endpoint pattern this limit applies to. Supports wildcards for pattern matching.

plainFields.name: request_limit
plainFields.description: Maximum number of requests allowed within the time window.

plainFields.name: time_window_seconds
plainFields.description: Time window in seconds for the rate limit. Common values: 60, 300, 3600, 86400.

plainFields.name: current_request_count
plainFields.description: Current request count within the active time window. Resets automatically when window expires.

plainFields.name: window_start_time
plainFields.description: Start time of the current rate limit window. Used for sliding window calculations.

plainFields.name: identifier_type
plainFields.description: Type of identifier for this rate limit. Values: 'user_id', 'ip_address', 'global'.

plainFields.name: identifier_value
plainFields.description: The actual identifier value. Could be user ID, IP address, or 'global'.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this rate limit rule is currently active and being enforced.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this rate limit rule was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification time for this rate limit rule.

models.name: todo_app_constraint_definitions
models.description:
Business rule and validation constraint definitions for the todo application.

Stores the specification for all business rules including data validation, format requirements, computational limits, and operational constraints applied throughout the system.

Each constraint definition includes validation logic, error messages, enforcement mechanisms, and applicability scope. Constraints can be global (system-wide) or contextual (applied based on conditions).

This centralized constraint management enables business rules to be modified without code changes while maintaining consistency across all system operations.

plainFields.name: constraint_name
plainFields.description: Unique name for this business rule constraint. Used for referencing in code and logs.

plainFields.name: constraint_type
plainFields.description: Type of constraint. Values: 'validation', 'limit', 'format', 'business_rule'.

plainFields.name: applicable_scope
plainFields.description: Where this constraint applies. Values: 'global', 'user', 'guest', 'task_creation', 'authentication'.

plainFields.name: constraint_definition
plainFields.description: JSON or structured definition of the constraint rule. Stores validation logic, format patterns, or business rule specifications.

plainFields.name: error_message_template
plainFields.description: Template for error messages when this constraint is violated. Can include placeholders for context-specific information.

plainFields.name: is_enforced
plainFields.description: Whether this constraint is currently being enforced. Allows soft disabling of rules without deletion.

plainFields.name: severity_level
plainFields.description: Severity when violated. Values: 'error' (blocks operation), 'warning' (allows with notification).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this constraint definition was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification time for this constraint definition.

models.name: todo_app_usage_metrics
models.description:
System usage metrics and analytics data for monitoring and business intelligence.

Captures operational data about API usage, task operations, authentication events, and system performance. This data drives rate limiting decisions, quota enforcement, and system optimization.

Usage metrics are collected asynchronously to minimize performance impact while providing comprehensive visibility into system operation patterns. Data supports both real-time monitoring and historical analysis.

Metrics enable proactive system management by identifying usage patterns, potential abuse scenarios, and areas requiring capacity planning or optimization.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: User associated with this metric. Null for global or guest metrics. {@link todo_app_users.id}

plainFields.name: metric_type
plainFields.description: Type of metric being recorded. Examples: 'api_request', 'task_operation', 'authentication_event'.

plainFields.name: metric_operation
plainFields.description: Specific operation or endpoint. Examples: 'task_create', 'login_attempt', 'search_query'.

plainFields.name: operation_count
plainFields.description: Number of operations captured in this metric record. Used for batching operations to minimize volume.

plainFields.name: response_time_ms
plainFields.description: Average response time in milliseconds for captured operations.

plainFields.name: status_code
plainFields.description: HTTP status code or operation result for captured requests.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string for web requests. Used for analytics and debugging.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: Client IP address, anonymized for privacy compliance.

plainFields.name: error_count
plainFields.description: Number of errors encountered in captured operations.

plainFields.name: metadata
plainFields.description: JSON metadata containing additional context relevant to the metric.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this usage metric was recorded.
